__solutions.lead: Why polypropylene is the right material for tomorrow's water supply, ecologically, technically, and economically.

benefits.d: Polypropylene originates from gases that were previously incinerated without purpose, drastically reducing air pollution. Production utilizes water in a closed cooling loop, protecting rivers, streams, and lakes.
PP carries recycling code "5" and can be separated by material type. We recycle all production waste and offcuts, amidst high demand for PP recyclate.
As an engineering plastic, PP is remarkably resistant to solvents, alkalis, and acids, molding complex geometries via injection molding at low costs and high volumes.
PP products last significantly longer than comparable materials: easy to maintain, wear-resistant, and resilient against aging and temperature extremes.

__solutions.nextLead: See how these material advantages become reality in the K-Aqua product range.

items.title: Legionella Prevention at the Molecular Level
items.desc: In critical hospital infrastructure, water hygiene is not an option but a matter of survival. Our K-Aqua piping systems utilize extremely smooth, pore-free inner surfaces that physically prevent biofilm formation and Legionella proliferation. German engineering here means: prevention through superior material science, not chemical post-treatment.

items.title: Thermal Disinfection Without Material Fatigue
items.desc: Clinical standards require regular thermal disinfection at temperatures above 70°C. While conventional systems age rapidly under these conditions, the K-Aqua PP-R system is designed for extreme thermal loads over decades. No microcracks, no embrittlement, no compromises.

items.title: Absolutely Sterile Connections
items.desc: Our socket fusion welding melts pipe and fitting into a homogeneous, completely seamless unit. No dead spaces are created where stagnant water could accumulate. The result is a piping system from a single mold, the ultimate physical barrier against contamination.

items.title: Acoustic Isolation for Intensive Care Units
items.desc: Noise is a massive stress factor for patients and medical staff. The K-Aqua system possesses inherent sound-absorbing properties. Flow noises and pressure surges are absorbed by the material itself, guaranteeing whisper-quiet water supply even in high-pressure applications, essential for operating rooms and ICUs.

items.title: System Dimensioning & Hydraulics
items.text: Precise calculation of pipe cross-sections to avoid stagnation zones. Every millimeter of pressure loss is simulated and eliminated on the digital twin by our German engineers during the planning phase.

items.title: Material Specification
items.text: Selection of specific K-Aqua polymer blends optimised for clinical requirements. Our raw materials undergo 42 quality assurance steps before even reaching the extruder.

items.title: Prefabrication & Cleanroom Handling
items.text: Pre-assembly of complex manifolds in controlled environments. Minimizing weld seams on site guarantees up to 40% faster, fault-free installation under cleanroom conditions.

items.title: Commissioning & Testing
items.text: Complete hydrostatic pressure testing and initial thermal disinfection. Handover to the general contractor includes comprehensive digital documentation of every single weld seam.

items.title: 50 Years Maintenance-Free
items.text: After commissioning, the system disappears into the wall and performs its duty silently and reliably, guaranteed for at least 50 years without any material fatigue.

hero.desc: In tertiary medical care, infrastructure determines life and death. K-Aqua delivers the hydrological nervous system for the world's most advanced hospital megaprojects. Manufactured in Germany. Built for eternity.

intro.title: Where a drop of water <br className="hidden md:block"/> causes the system to collapse.
intro.desc: General contractors face an unsolvable paradox in hospital projects: enormous time pressure during construction meets the strictest hygienic requirements in human history. A single dead space in the piping network, a microscopic crack, a corroding joint, and millions in investment are at risk. We solve this paradox through pure, uncompromising German engineering.

stickySection.title: The Anatomy of Safety.
stickySection.lead: We view a hospital not as a building, but as a biological organism. The K-Aqua system is its indestructible vascular system. Every millimeter of our piping is calibrated for absolute reliability.

bentoSection.title: Economic Efficiency Through Perfection.
bentoSection.lead: Quality is not a cost factor, but the only path to profitability in building automation. K-Aqua minimizes the Total Cost of Ownership to an unprecedented level while guaranteeing maximum patient safety.

items.title: 100% Corrosion Resistance
items.desc: Unlike metallic pipes, K-Aqua is completely immune to electrochemical corrosion, pitting, and calcareous water. No encrustation, no pressure loss over 50 years of continuous operation.

items.title: Lightning-Fast Installation
items.desc: Low dead weight and homogeneous welding technology reduce installation time by up to 40%. Fewer man-days, lower risk on site.

items.title: Earthquake-Safe Flexibility
items.desc: The modular molecular structure of the material allows it to absorb seismic shocks and building settlements without breaking. Essential for hospitals in risk zones.

items.title: Tested Drinking Water Quality
items.desc: Meets and exceeds the world's strictest standards (DIN, DVGW, SKZ, WRAS) for transporting ultra-pure water and highly sensitive clinical media.
